content:
STAGE 1 - scope contract check on all six proposals (rubric rank-2026-10-v1).
GOAL: decide whether any proposal must be sent back (out of scope) before ranking.
READ: the six proposal texts plus their frozen evidence bundles (DELTA-PERI-CURV-RQ fab5ef5625b65791, DELTA-TREE-STRESS-RQ 4bf56163b70e0975, GDELTA-SUCC-PULL-RQ a417488dd3f577d2, GROMOV-LCA-MOBIUS-RQ 40ac3b24c042bf37, SID-GW-DELTA b2e460e970104c8c, LCB-RQ e06573d4519f3d92); common observed items E5-E11.
OBSERVED: every candidate names (1) a training-only behaviour signal computed from train-split transitions/co-consumption, (2) an explicit curved operation (variable Poincare, trainable Poincare, per-item-K Poincare, fixed-c Mobius, fixed-kappa Poincare, Lorentz) and where it acts in Stage-2, (3) one connected pathway in which removing behaviour or geometry changes the core computation, (4) the behaviour-off/Euclidean/both-on switches plus a one-run observable, (5) equations/pseudocode, inputs/outputs, safeguards and cost. LCB-RQ and SID-GW-DELTA are the weakest on coupling/derivation but neither is a behaviour suffix on an unchanged quantiser nor a detached auxiliary loss.
REASONING: no candidate triggers the scope rejection clauses; the differences are strength-of-coupling and evidence grounding, so all six are scored/ranked, none excluded.
OPEN: none on admissibility.

STAGE 2 - evidence-grounded ordering decision.
GOAL: place the six in-scope proposals using only the frozen bundle.
READ: E5 (top-1 successor mass 0.4375 lowest-entropy quintile vs 0.0543 highest; Spearman(entropy,top1)=-0.973), E6 (width-20 beam: l1_br 0.04671, l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363, successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500; target-in-beams 0.0678-0.0884; gold prefix alive depth3/4 0.156-0.161 / 0.068-0.085), E7 (T1-T4 NLL; best arms keep T2/T3 predictable), E8 (shared-cluster rate K=16 0.3106, K=32 0.2164, K=64 0.1547, K=256 0.0822 vs negative 0.1352/0.0715/0.0376/0.0129), E9 (cohort-profile 0.9291 vs 0.8871; 0.5898 rank dominance), E10 (115582 distinct edges, mean out-degree 5.45), E11 (same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067).
OBSERVED / REASONING:
(a) The recall ceiling is prefix survival at depths 3-4 (0.085 max) and the best arms are the ones that preserve text information (0.0621-0.0636) while every behaviour-tilted arm (0.0512-0.0550) lost. So the ranking must favour mechanisms that add behaviour without sacrificing reconstruction.
(b) E8 shows the measured headroom is in coarse prefix sharing (0.3106 at K=16 collapsing to 0.0822 at K=256), i.e. the lever is the discrete assignment/prefix, not a post-hoc metric.
(c) E5 shows the behaviour signal is strongly concentrated in directed top-1 successors, which grounds successor/transition mechanisms and gives no support to LCB's undirected window co-consumption.
PLACEMENT: 1 GDELTA-SUCC-PULL-RQ (changes only the per-level argmin, keeps baseline recon+commit losses, successor signal grounded by E5, prefix-sharing lever grounded by E8, weight derived as 1 by detached unit medians, 1-3% cost). 2 DELTA-TREE-STRESS-RQ (only proposal stressing the quantized code embedding at every prefix depth, i.e. directly targets the depth3/4 survival ceiling in E6; few-% cost, alpha/lambda measured; weaker because the MST path-max target is a distortion of d_beh and c=1/delta^2 can blow up). 3 DELTA-PERI-CURV-RQ (tightest single-pathway reuse of c_i, E5 supports per-item heterogeneity, but it acts mainly on the continuous latent, per-pair sqrt(c_i c_j) is not a metric, and it carries the largest cost +35-50% with init-only lambda). 4 GROMOV-LCA-MOBIUS-RQ (genuinely curved quantiser and clean Gromov-product/LCA target, but c fixed at 1, 6-level/64-leaf target is near-binary, E8 says 64-way sharing is only 0.1547). 5 SID-GW-DELTA (kappa=-1/delta^2 on unnormalised d_beh clipped to [0.01*diam,diam] can collapse to near-Euclidean, median normalisation dominated by 128 random items, aligns decoded-code distances rather than forcing prefixes). 6 LCB-RQ (undirected co-consumption not matched by E5, a_i=m_i/(m_i+median m) sends popular items' target to ~neighbour Frechet mean and erases the text identity E7 shows matters, K->0 and anchor-less tail items from E10 make it partly a no-op).
OPEN: none; ordering is grounded in E5-E11 for every placement.

STAGE 3 - final answer (complete block, last record).
RANK: GDELTA-SUCC-PULL-RQ | position=1 | reason=E8 measures the prefix-sharing headroom (0.3106 at K=16 down to 0.0822 at K=256) and E5 grounds the directed successor signal (top-1 mass 0.4375), while this is the only candidate that changes just the per-level argmin and keeps the baseline recon+commit losses, so it avoids the E6/E7 pattern where behaviour-tilted arms (0.0512-0.0550) lost to Euclidean 0.0621-0.0636, with the weight derived as 1 by detached unit medians at 1-3% cost.
RANK: DELTA-TREE-STRESS-RQ | position=2 | reason=E6 caps recall by gold-prefix survival of only 0.156-0.161 at depth 3 and 0.068-0.085 at depth 4, and this is the only proposal that puts the curved stress on the quantized code embedding at every prefix depth, at a few-% cost with alpha and lambda measured, though the MST path-max target distorts d_beh and c=1/delta^2 can saturate the ball.
RANK: DELTA-PERI-CURV-RQ | position=3 | reason=E5 supports per-item heterogeneity and the single-c_i pathway is the tightest coupling, but the contrastive acts mainly on the continuous latent (reaching SIDs only via the commitment term), per-pair sqrt(c_i c_j) curvature is not a metric by its own risk 3, and it carries the largest +35-50% Stage-2 cost with init-only lambda, the configuration most exposed to the E6/E7 fact that behaviour-tilted arms underperformed Euclidean.
RANK: GROMOV-LCA-MOBIUS-RQ | position=4 | reason=the curved Mobius quantiser and Gromov-product/LCA target are genuinely coupled and well specified, but curvature is fixed at c=1 rather than measured, the 6-level/64-leaf tree makes the target near-binary by its own risk 1, and E8 shows 64-way cluster sharing reaches only 0.1547, so the LCA target can only coarsely carry the top-1 successor mass E5 measures at 0.4375.
RANK: SID-GW-DELTA | position=5 | reason=kappa=-1/delta^2 applied to an unnormalised d_beh whose delta is clipped to [0.01*diam, diam] can make the ball near-Euclidean (its own risk 1), the median normalisation is dominated by the 128 uniform random items, and it fits a pairwise distance matrix on decoded code vectors rather than forcing prefix sharing, which E8/E6 identify as the actual lever.
RANK: LCB-RQ | position=6 | reason=it is grounded in undirected window co-consumption whereas the measured support is successor concentration (E5 top-1 mass 0.4375), its a_i=m_i/(m_i+median m) sends high-mass items to approximately the neighbour Frechet mean and discards the text identity E7 shows T2/T3 NLL depends on, and K->0 plus the 5.45-mean-degree anchor-less tail in E10 make it partly a no-op.
This is the complete answer and supersedes no earlier record.
